roadmap.title: Prologue and first events
roadmap.description: Finish The Opening Act, the Qualifiers and the first race, then buy a car and try the basic event types while driving around.

roadmap.title: Horizon Festival wristbands
roadmap.description: Win Festival races and finish each Wristband Event from Green to Gold, entering Legend Island in the final race.

roadmap.title: Discover Japan and collectibles
roadmap.description: Do Story events, Touge Battles, Food Delivery, houses and collectibles until the Gold Stamp; start the Festival Playlist early.

roadmap.title: Cars, garage and Car Meets
roadmap.description: Buy the Tokyo House, the 2025 GR GT Prototype and a Track Toy, then park at the Car Meets.

roadmap.title: Online and weekly goals
roadmap.description: Do the short online tasks, then keep up the weekly Festival Playlist and the long Horizon Play level grind.

achievements.description: Earn the Yellow Wristband and join the Horizon Festival.
achievements.summary: Qualify for the Horizon Festival by earning the Yellow Wristband.

steps.text: Complete every other @mechanic{Qualifier} race and the @mechanic{Horizon Invitational}. Qualifying hands you the Yellow Wristband.

achievements.description: Earn the Yellow Stamp for your Collection Journal.
achievements.summary: Earn the Yellow Stamp in the Discover Japan Collection Journal.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Campaign > Collection Journal > Discover Japan} when the Yellow Stamp is announced, and claim it.

achievements.description: Complete your first Touge event.
achievements.summary: Complete your first @mechanic{Touge} event.

steps.text: Filter the map for Touge Battles, pick the first one offered, and drive it to the end. A win is not needed.

achievements.description: Complete your first Job.
achievements.summary: Complete your first @mechanic{Job}.

steps.text: Drive to the big blue @mechanic{Tokyo City Food Delivery} marker in the middle of Tokyo and do one delivery.

achievements.description: Earn the Green Horizon Festival Wristband.
achievements.summary: Earn the Green Horizon Festival Wristband.

steps.text: Win Festival races until the Journal announces @mechanic{Pier Pressure}, then finish that Wristband Event.

achievements.description: Earn the Blue Horizon Festival Wristband.
achievements.summary: Earn the Blue Horizon Festival Wristband.

steps.text: Keep racing in the Festival until @mechanic{Mech My Day} becomes available. Complete it and take the Blue Wristband.

achievements.description: Earn the Green Stamp in your Collection Journal.
achievements.summary: Earn the Green Stamp in the Discover Japan Collection Journal.

steps.text: When the Green Stamp is announced, open @mechanic{Discover Japan} and claim it. It comes from normal progress such as Story events, races and collectibles.

achievements.description: Earn the Blue Stamp in your Collection Journal.
achievements.summary: Earn the Blue Stamp in the Discover Japan Collection Journal.

steps.text: When the Blue Stamp is announced, open @mechanic{Discover Japan} and claim it.

achievements.displayName: A Fine Addition To My Collection
achievements.description: Discover and claim a Treasure Car.
achievements.summary: Discover and claim any @mechanic{Treasure Car}.

steps.text: Enter a region to get a clue photo, then find that car and press Collect.
If you cannot spot it, use drone mode (pause, then D-pad down and up). A purple icon appears on the map when you are close.

achievements.description: Purchase an Aftermarket Car.
achievements.summary: Buy an @mechanic{Aftermarket Car} from a roadside offer.

guide.context: The green icon only shows while you are close, and it disappears when you drive away. One sits next to the Tokyo House.

steps.text: While driving, stop at a green car icon on the map and buy the discounted car it offers.

achievements.description: Set a lap time at a Time Attack Circuit.
achievements.summary: Finish a lap at a @mechanic{Time Attack Circuit} to set a lap time.

steps.text: Go to any @mechanic{Time Attack} event (blue clock icon) and finish one full lap.

achievements.description: Complete a Drag Meet.
achievements.summary: Finish a run at a @mechanic{Drag Meet}.

guide.context: The first @mechanic{Drag Meet} appears on the map after you earn the Yellow Wristband.

steps.text: Go to any @mechanic{Drag Meet} event (red lights icon) and finish one run.

achievements.description: Complete a LINK Skill.
achievements.summary: Complete a @mechanic{LINK Skill} with another player.

guide.context: Offline AI avatars do not count. It must be another real player.

steps.text: While roaming the online world, drive close to another human player and pull off the same Skill (any move that adds a score pop-up near the top of your view) at the same time, such as a drift or a near miss.
Horizon Stunt Parties gather many players, which makes this easier.

achievements.description: Complete a Horizon Rush course.
achievements.summary: Complete a @mechanic{Horizon Rush} course.

steps.text: Start the Wristband Event @mechanic{Pier Pressure} and finish its @mechanic{Horizon Rush} course.

achievements.description: Purchase the Yashiki Player House.
achievements.summary: Buy the @loc{Yashiki Player House}.

steps.text: Earn the Yellow Stamp. The house north of Tokyo then appears on the map; go there and buy it for 10,000 CP.

achievements.description: Earn 3 Stars on any Day Trip Story Chapter.
achievements.summary: Score the top 3-star result on one @mechanic{Day Trip} Story chapter.

steps.text: Filter the map for Stories and begin any @mechanic{Day Trip}.
Meet the target shown at the start, such as a time or an average speed, to earn all 3 stars. If you fall short, press Retry.

achievements.description: Purchase a car from the Autoshow.
achievements.summary: Buy a car from the @loc{Autoshow}.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Cars}, then @mechanic{Buy New & Used Cars}, then the @loc{Autoshow}. Order the list by value and buy whichever car you like.

achievements.description: Complete the Mech My Day Showcase Event.
achievements.summary: Finish the @mechanic{Mech My Day} Showcase.

steps.text: When @mechanic{Mech My Day} opens, finish its Showcase Event, then accept the Blue Wristband.

achievements.description: Earn 10 levels in Horizon Play.
achievements.summary: Earn 10 levels in @mechanic{Horizon Play}.

guide.context: Only online Horizon Play events give this XP. Single-player races and free roam do not.

steps.text: Play online events in @mechanic{Online > Horizon Play} and stay through each results screen to earn XP.

achievements.description: Smash your first Regional Mascot.
achievements.summary: Smash your first Regional Mascot.

steps.text: Drive through any Regional Mascot out in the world to smash it.

achievements.description: Win your first Horizon Festival Race event.
achievements.summary: Come first in your first Festival race.

steps.text: Win the next @mechanic{Horizon Festival} race the game offers. Choose the @mechanic{Tourist} difficulty for an easy early win.

achievements.description: Earn the Pink Horizon Festival Wristband.
achievements.summary: Earn the Pink Horizon Festival Wristband.

steps.text: Keep earning Festival points. When invited, start @mechanic{Off Piste} and finish its @mechanic{Horizon Rush} course to get the Pink Wristband.

achievements.displayName: Orange You Glad You Made It?
achievements.description: Earn the Orange Horizon Festival Wristband.
achievements.summary: Earn the Orange Horizon Festival Wristband.

steps.text: Keep earning Festival points until @mechanic{Fight Club} opens. Finish its Flight Club Showcase and take the Orange Wristband.

achievements.description: Earn the Pink Stamp in your Collection Journal.
achievements.summary: Earn the Pink Stamp in the Discover Japan Collection Journal.

steps.text: When the Pink Stamp is announced, open @mechanic{Discover Japan} and claim it.

achievements.description: Earn the Orange Stamp in your Collection Journal.
achievements.summary: Earn the Orange Stamp in the Discover Japan Collection Journal.

steps.text: When the Orange Stamp is announced, open @mechanic{Discover Japan} and claim it.

achievements.description: Discover all 10 Regions.
achievements.summary: Discover all 10 regions.

guide.context: The other nine are Sotoyama, Takashiro, Hokubu, Ito, Minamino, Ohtani, Shimanoyama, Tokyo City and Nangan. @loc{Legend Island} in the east only opens at the end of the Festival story.

steps.text: Keep winning Festival races until the last Wristband Event, @mechanic{Horizon Legend}, begins. Drive into @loc{Legend Island} during that race to discover the tenth region.

achievements.description: Complete 33 activities in the Tokyo City Region.
achievements.summary: Finish any 33 activities listed for the @loc{Tokyo City} region.

guide.context: These add up on their own while you collect Mascots and Bonus Boards and play the Story.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Tokyo City} region view on the map and finish any 33 of its 125 listed activities, such as races, collectibles and Story events.

achievements.description: Earn 36 Stars from PR Stunts in the Ohtani Region.
achievements.summary: Collect a total of 36 stars across the PR Stunts in @loc{Ohtani}.

guide.context: @loc{Ohtani} holds 13 stunts: Speed Traps (3), Speed Zones (4), Danger Signs (3), a Drift Zone (1) and Trailblazers (2). Three stars on each is not required.

steps.text: Reach the Purple Wristband so all 13 @loc{Ohtani} PR Stunts are available. Open the map filter for PR Stunts.
Work on the stunts you find easiest first, then keep improving until the @loc{Ohtani} star total reaches 36.

achievements.description: Complete 5 Touge Races.
achievements.summary: Complete 5 @mechanic{Touge} Races.

steps.text: Finish all five Touge Battles: Hakone Nanamagari, Bandai Azuma, Arashiyama Takao, Mt. Haruna and Norikura Skyline. You do not have to win.
Each one shows on the map filter only after you drive near it, so explore each region first.

achievements.displayName: What Are You Doing In My Estate?
achievements.description: Visit another player's Estate.
achievements.summary: Visit another player's Estate.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Creative Hub > Estates} and select any Estate. Choose View Creative Hub, then Visit Their Estate.
If that option is missing, select a different Estate whose owner allows visits.

achievements.description: Display 3 different cars in your Garage at the same time.
achievements.summary: Put three different cars on display in your garage together.

steps.text: Get the Tokyo House: it costs 3,000,000 credits, or comes free with the Premium Edition.
In the garage menu, go to @mechanic{Customizable Garage}, then @mechanic{Display Cars}, and put a different car in each of the three slots.

achievements.description: Collect 100 different cars.
achievements.summary: Own 100 different cars.

guide.context: The Cars Owned number in the Cars menu counts duplicates, so it is not a reliable count.

steps.text: Claim free cars first: Festival rewards, rewards in both Collection Journals, Wheelspins, Treasure Cars and Barn Finds.
Buy the cheapest missing cars from the @loc{Autoshow} (filter by Value) until you reach 100.
Read your true count in @mechanic{My Horizon}, @mechanic{Badges}, @mechanic{Campaign}, then the Growing Collection badge.

achievements.description: Complete the Flight Club Showcase Event.
achievements.summary: Complete the Flight Club Showcase Event.

steps.text: When @mechanic{Fight Club} opens, finish the Flight Club Showcase Event.

achievements.description: Park at 3 different Car Meets.
achievements.summary: Park at 3 different @mechanic{Car Meets}.

steps.text: Park at each of the three meets: Daikoku Parking Area, Horizon Festival and Okuibuki. Drive up, enter a parking space and confirm the prompt.
Find them with the Car Meets map filter. Each appears after you drive near it.

achievements.description: Drive any R Class Car.
achievements.summary: Drive a car with the R performance class.

guide.context: Premium Edition owners already own several R class cars.

steps.text: Get any car with the pink @mechanic{R} class rating and drive it. Filter the @loc{Autoshow} by R class to find one; the cheapest costs 65,000 credits.

achievements.description: Complete a Race Event within a Spec Racing Championship.
achievements.summary: Complete a race in a @mechanic{Spec Racing} Championship.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Online}, then @mechanic{Horizon Play}, then @mechanic{Spec Racing}, and join a Championship. Wait for one race to show its results screen. Winning or finishing is not needed.

achievements.description: Earn at least 1 Star at the Irokawa Launch Danger Sign.
achievements.summary: Get one star or better on the @mechanic{Irokawa Launch} Danger Sign.

steps.text: Earn the Purple Wristband. Only then does the @mechanic{Irokawa Launch} ramp appear, in the map's south-west corner.
Pick a car that accelerates fast and drive up the marked approach road at full speed.
Jump at least 243.8 meters to earn the first star.

achievements.description: Park the 2025 GR GT Prototype at a Car Meet.
achievements.summary: Leave the 2025 GR GT Prototype in a parking bay at a @mechanic{Car Meet}.

steps.text: Purchase the 2025 GR GT Prototype in the @loc{Autoshow}, listed under the GR maker, for 250,000 credits.
Drive it to any Car Meet, such as the one right outside the Horizon Festival Site, enter a parking space and confirm the prompt.

achievements.description: Set a lap time at a Time Attack Circuit while driving any Track Toy.
achievements.summary: Set a @mechanic{Time Attack Circuit} lap time in a @mechanic{Track Toy} car.

steps.text: Purchase a car of the @mechanic{Track Toys} type in the @loc{Autoshow}. The cheapest is the 2017 Mazda MX-5 Cup at 60,000 credits.
Take it to a @mechanic{Time Attack} event and complete a full lap.

achievements.description: Earn all Playlist points for a Season.
achievements.summary: Earn every Festival Playlist point available in one Season.

guide.context: A Season lasts one week. Seasonal collectibles are not shown by the Treasure Map add-on.

steps.text: Unlock the Festival Playlist by earning the Yellow Wristband, then open @mechanic{Campaign > Festival Playlist}.
Finish every activity that gives Playlist points before the weekly reset, including the Daily Challenges, until your points equal the Season's maximum.

achievements.description: Discover 10 Landmarks.
achievements.summary: Discover 10 Landmarks.

steps.text: Drive between events instead of fast travelling. Driving past a Landmark discovers it, and you do not need to stop or interact.

achievements.description: Earn the Purple Horizon Festival Wristband.
achievements.summary: Earn the Purple Horizon Festival Wristband.

steps.text: Keep earning Festival points until @mechanic{Launch Control} opens. Finish its @mechanic{Horizon Rush} course, then accept the Purple Wristband.

achievements.description: Earn the Gold Horizon Festival Wristband and become a Horizon Legend.
achievements.summary: Earn the Gold Horizon Festival Wristband.

steps.text: Win more Festival races until the last Wristband Event, @mechanic{Horizon Legend}, unlocks. Complete it and take the Gold Wristband.

achievements.description: Earn the Purple Stamp in your Collection Journal.
achievements.summary: Earn the Purple Stamp in the Discover Japan Collection Journal.

steps.text: When the Purple Stamp is announced, open @mechanic{Discover Japan} and claim it.

achievements.description: Earn the Gold Stamp and become a Master Explorer.
achievements.summary: Earn the Gold Stamp in the Discover Japan Collection Journal.

guide.context: You only need about half of everything listed. You do not need 3 stars on every Street Race or Touge Battle.

steps.text: Raise your @mechanic{Discover Japan} points with Story events, Street Races, Touge Battles, Food Delivery promotions, houses and Regional Mascots.
When the Gold Stamp is available, open @mechanic{Discover Japan} and claim it.

achievements.description: Earn the maximum Promotion in a Job.
achievements.summary: Reach the top promotion level in a @mechanic{Job}.

guide.context: Each shift has three deliveries. Your promotion level rises with the total money you earn from deliveries.

steps.text: Keep doing @mechanic{Tokyo City Food Delivery} shifts until you reach promotion level 9. Your level shows when you hover over the map icon.
Aim for 3 stars on each delivery, since that pays more and promotes you faster.
Let @mechanic{Autodrive} handle deliveries judged on time alone. For deliveries that need drifting or a Skill score, drive yourself.

achievements.description: Discover and claim 9 Treasure Cars.
achievements.summary: Discover and claim 9 @mechanic{Treasure Cars}.

guide.context: There is one Treasure Car in each of the nine main regions. Entering a region gives you a clue photo. Press Collect on the car; you can drive it at once. Track them under @mechanic{Cars > Treasure Cars}.

collectibles.name: Nissan Figaro '91
collectibles.location: Little parking lot beside the river, southern end, where several bridges run close
collectibles.method: The Rainbow Bridge in the clue photo is visible everywhere, so skip it. Check the lot on the waterfront and press Collect.

collectibles.name: Dodge Charger '69
collectibles.location: Behind the golf course clubhouse on the east side
collectibles.method: Approach the clubhouse from the rear and press Collect.

collectibles.name: Mazda RX-7 GSL-SE '85
collectibles.location: Next to one of the large power transmission antennas
collectibles.method: Find the cluster of antennas, check the base of each, and press Collect.

collectibles.name: Porsche 959 '87
collectibles.location: Outside a 365 shop in the small town near the top of the region
collectibles.method: Pick the 365 shop in that town (the region has several) and press Collect.

collectibles.name: BMW M1 '81
collectibles.location: Far end of the railway bridge, in upper Hokubu
collectibles.method: Follow the bridge to its end and press Collect.

collectibles.name: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution III GSR '95
collectibles.location: Riverside, at the far western edge
collectibles.method: Drive to the riverbank and press Collect.

collectibles.name: Lancia Stratos HF Stradale '74
collectibles.location: Midway up the mountain, a short way below the Off Piste Wristband event
collectibles.method: Roll down the slope from the Off Piste event icon and press Collect.

collectibles.name: Ford GT '05
collectibles.location: On the unmarked coastal trail beside the orange road section in the far south
collectibles.method: Follow the trail along the coast and press Collect.

collectibles.name: Nissan Safari Turbo '85
collectibles.location: Beneath a windmill in the wind farm on the eastern edge, slightly southwest of where the Turbine Trailer Drift Zone sits
collectibles.method: Find that windmill and press Collect.

achievements.description: Reveal the entire Map.
achievements.summary: Reveal the entire map.

guide.context: @mechanic{Autodrive} can follow a selected road and unfog it for you.

steps.text: Drive each region's roads until its fog clears. Check each region's discovered percentage on the map region view.
Finish @loc{Legend Island} last, since it opens only after the Gold Wristband. The achievement unlocks as you drive around it.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Horizon Rush events.
achievements.summary: Complete 3 @mechanic{Horizon Rush} events.

steps.text: Finish three @mechanic{Horizon Rush} courses. The Wristband Events @mechanic{Pier Pressure}, @mechanic{Off Piste} and @mechanic{Launch Control} each include one.

achievements.description: Earn 100 levels in Horizon Play.
achievements.summary: Earn 100 levels in @mechanic{Horizon Play}.

guide.context: This is a very long grind. Install the latest game update first; it may lower the XP needed for higher levels.

steps.text: Keep playing online events in @mechanic{Online > Horizon Play}. Your level is shown at the top left of that screen.
Stay through every results screen. Finishing gives XP, and a better placement gives more.

achievements.description: Earn a Series History Reward.
achievements.summary: Earn a Series History Reward.

guide.context: Points add up across Series. At about 45 points a week, expect roughly 12 weeks, so start early.

steps.text: Earn the Yellow Wristband to unlock the Festival Playlist, then complete the weekly activities every Season.
Track your total under @mechanic{Festival Playlist > History > Playlist History}. The first reward costs 500 points.
Claim the reward once you reach the total.

achievements.description: Smash 200 Regional Mascots.
achievements.summary: Smash 200 Regional Mascots.

steps.text: Unfog the map first, then fast travel between Mascots and drive through each one to smash it. Smashing them also raises your Discover Japan points.
The optional Treasure Map add-on from Steam shows Mascot locations on your map.

achievements.description: Smash 200 Bonus Boards.
achievements.summary: Smash 200 Bonus Boards.

steps.text: Unfog the map first, then fast travel between Bonus Boards and drive through each one to smash it.
The optional Treasure Map add-on from Steam shows Bonus Board locations on your map.

achievements.description: Win 57 Horizon Festival Race Events.
achievements.summary: Win 57 Horizon Festival Race events.

guide.context: There are more than 57 qualifying races, so you can skip a few.

steps.text: Win Road, Dirt, Cross Country and Drag races and Wristband Events, finishing 1st each time. Check your win count under @mechanic{Campaign > Collection Journal > Horizon Festival}.
For easy wins, play on @mechanic{Tourist} difficulty and turn on @mechanic{Autodrive}.

achievements.description: Earn 81 Stars from Stories.
achievements.summary: Earn 81 stars from Stories.

guide.context: Each chapter has you drive to a spot and switch to a set car, so you cannot use your own supercar for the scored part. Rewind also resets your time.

steps.text: Earn 3 stars in all 27 Story chapters: 9 @mechanic{Day Trips} (27 stars), then @mechanic{Drift Club}, @mechanic{Yuji's Auto} and @mechanic{Moto Auto Zine} (18 stars each).
After a result under 3 stars, press Retry right away. On later replays, skip ahead to the scored challenge from the story select screen.
Use @mechanic{Autodrive} for time targets. Drive Speed Zone and Skill-score chapters yourself, because @mechanic{Autodrive} usually earns only 2 stars there.

achievements.description: Complete The Opening Act.
achievements.summary: Finish the prologue chapter, @mechanic{The Opening Act}.

steps.text: Follow the guided arrival and finish the first @mechanic{Street Race} to complete @mechanic{The Opening Act}. This unlocks on its own about 20 minutes in.

achievements.description: Complete your first Qualifier event.
achievements.summary: Complete the first @mechanic{Horizon Qualifier} event.

steps.text: After @mechanic{The Opening Act}, finish the first available @mechanic{Qualifier} race.
